KetoClub — three visual directions, same two screens each.

Pick one and I'll build the full app into it: discovery/search, restaurant page, menu with traffic-light marks, waiter card, and settings with the API key.

The filter chips and the "Ask your waiter" panels are live in all three — click them.
Photo tiles are placeholders; real images come from the Wolt/10bis feeds.
